note: Formal garden between Hall (N), Block B (S) and Block A (E). Garden frame: origin M=(131.07,-28.03) = midpoint of the gazebo centres, u along the campus grid (0.99881,-0.04885), v grid-north. Paths are 1.2 m (3 x 0.40 m diamond concrete tiles) with scalloped concrete edging and ~1.05 m clipped hedges both sides; 'path' elements are paving data (builder skips them; terrain = paving). The garden floor is ~1 m below the Block-B side (boulder retaining wall along the south); the smooth terrain model does not carry that step.

elements.name: Gazebo_1
elements.notes: across_flats = post-centre octagon (builder convention). Eave (fascia bottom) = 2.77 m; apex ~5.0 m at 25 deg. Pier/parapet: red brick-effect tile (2026; plain maroon paint in 2020), white render posts with dark-brown capital band ~0.12 m.
elements.evidence: Octagon (8 posts, 8 sides) with pyramid shingle roof. Plan size: Google z20 roof outline across flats 9.15 m (vertex-N octagon R=4.95 fits the N/NW/NE/E roof edge, 0.1 m/px); post-centre size from the 2020 in-gazebo 360 pano (tour360 gazebo.jpg): 7 visible parapet-base corners fitted by a regular octagon (rms 0.2 h), inner corner radius 2.60 h, fitted centre coincides with the central column (0.1 h); camera h=1.55 m from floor tiles 0.25 h = 0.39 m (0.40 m diamond tiles) and roof size -> post-centre AF 7.7-7.9. Front frame 081924271 t7: side c-c 743 px vs 0.95 m brick-tile stub 225 px -> 3.1-3.2 m side = AF 7.5-7.7. Heights (pano, h=1.55): parapet top 0.61 h = 0.95 m (stub: 6.6 courses of 0.125 m brick tiles + cap), post top 1.665 h = 2.58 m. Openings: 2 adjacent sides (SSE, SSW) each with ~0.8 m parapet stubs either side of a ~1.1-1.2 m clear gap (pano pz_180, frames 081924271 t7-t10); all other 6 sides parapet + continuous wooden bench. Paved apron ~1.3 m wide between parapet and edging/hedge (pano, 081924271 t12). Floor flush with paths (same diamond tiles, no step). Roof: brown asphalt shingles, white fascia with dark triangular tabs, sloped slatted soffit, dark-brown round central column d=0.20 m from floor to soffit (pano: 8.1 deg at 0.9 h). Centre: Google z20 roof (116.95,-26.75) minus north lean 0.18 m/m (Google B roof edge 1.3-1.7 m N of the Bing footprint) averaged with Bing 2021 (116.6,-26.6), then both gazebos snapped symmetric on the -2.8 deg campus grid (moves each <=0.35 m). Orientation from the 2020 pano: C block (4 fl.) at pano yaw 54-59 = bearing 58-63 from here -> pano yaw offset +4 deg -> a post (vertex) points grid-N, openings face bearings 160/205; confirmed by the SSE path on Google z20 (bearing 161.6, radial) and the N path at x=117.4 hitting the N vertex.
